Special Council Meeting CITY OF SOLANA BEACH
ACTION AGENDA
The Action Agenda of the City Council Meeting is a document provided immediately following the Council Meeting in order for staff and the public to be aware of the business transacted and actions taken by Council. This is a preliminary draft and not a public record. The meeting's legal record is the Minutes approved by the City Council.
SOLANA BEACH CITY COUNCIL
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY and PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY
JOINT SPECIAL MEETING
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 26, 2008
07:00 P.M.
CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
635 S. HIGHWAY 101
SOLANA BEACH, CALIFORNIA
The City Council acts as the City of Solana Beach Redevelopment Agency and the Public Financing Authority.
NOTICE
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, persons with a disability may request an agenda in appropriate alternative formats as required by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Any person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should direct such request to the City Clerk's office at (858) 720-2400 at least 48 hours before the meeting.
As a courtesy to all meeting attendees, please set cellular phones and pagers to silent mode and engage in conversations outside the Council Chambers.
The Regular Meetings of the City Council are scheduled for 2nd and 4th Wednesdays and are broadcast live on Cox Communications, Channel 19, and Time Warner, Channel 24.
A full City Council agenda packet with all backup information is available at City Hall and the Solana Beach branch of the San Diego County Library the Friday before each Council meeting and on the web at www.ci.solana-beach.ca.us at least 72 hours prior to the meeting. Agenda related writings or documents that are regarding an agenda item and received after the distribution of the agenda but at least 1 hour and 30 minutes prior to the meeting on the meeting day will be available for public viewing at City Hall and posted online with the agenda.

Item 8 Report (click here)

David Ott, City Manager, introduced the item.
Kathy Johnson, Assistant Planner, presented a Powerpoint.
Mayor Kellejian opened the public hearing.
Elaine Dellinger, applicant, said that the project was simple and that the initial issues with the project had been addressed.
Ken Karr stated that he asked people what they thought about the addition and did not recieve any feedback regarding problems, that he supported the project, and that his concerns regarding in the area due to two current projects creating a lot of noise in the area were addressed by the applicant assured him that they would make sure construction was compliant with appropriate work hours.
Ed Strauss said that he lived next door to the project area, that the staff report did not take into consideration off-street parking, that the area is covered with bushes and shrubs, and that offset parking needs to be supplied, and requested that the area be cleared to make room for parking as well as the room for the fire hydrant clearance.
Staff and Council reviewed pictures of the area covered by shrubs.
Tina Christiansen, Community Development Dir., said that it was not a requirement as far as a code enforcement issue, however, the Council could require the removal of plants in the right-of-way as a condition of project for parking.
Elaine Dellinger, applicant, stated that her goal was for the project to not impact the area as much as recent projects had done, that they intended to ask the workman to delay the noise to closer to 8:00 a.m., and that she planned to have the workers use her driveway and lot as much as possible to limit their parking on the street.
Council, staff, applicant and architect discussed the type of fencing which would be wrought iron, that they had not yet decided on landscaping, would create some parking in cleaning from shrubbery, that the driveway would enlarge, clearing more area for parking access for the workmen, trimming the area abutting the stop sign, removing some junipers along the area, and utilizing shrubs to deter people climbing the fence which had been an issue in the past.
MOTION: Moved by Nichols and seconded by Kellejian to close the public hearing. Motion carried 4/0/1 ( Absent: Campbell.)
Council discussion ensued regarding clearing some areas to open up for more parking, trimming some shrubs to clear the stop sign area, and street sign issues for public safety.
MOTION: Moved by Roberts and seconded by Kellejian to reopen the public hearing. Motion carried 4/0/1 ( Absent: Campbell.)
Council discussed with the applicants the clearing of the stop sign area, and more room on the telephone pole area for the mail man, opening their gate for their visitors limiting parking on the street, and the use of the gate for safety at night and detering walk-ins.
MOTION: Moved by Roberts and seconded by Kellejian to approve adding a condition to clear shrubs on Canyon Place at least 2 ft. from edge of asphalt and maintain clearance. Motion carried 4/0/1 ( Absent: Campbell.)
